source.title: Virtuous Silver Faulds — original Wowhead Looter disenchant occurrence table
source.author: Wowhead Looter cumulative submissions

notes: Original Wowhead item-specific cumulative Looter disenchant table, distinct from other gear-item pools; PTR/live localized views of this same ID are not independent. 'X out of Y' is a per-material appearance/hit count, NOT material total units. Multiple materials can occur on one disenchant; do not assume exclusive outcomes or calculate any zero-result casts. Output positive-stack ranges are not 0-N histograms. Exact item bonus/difficulty variants, enchant skill/spec, sample patch/build/dataDate, output total quantities and joint-event data are not published. The item's introduction patch is not the sample's patch.
